headline: Nairobi (HKJK): MVFR Conditions; BKN Ceiling 1600ft
body: Visibility reduced to 6 miles in light rain; winds from 120° at 5 kts. Transitioning to VFR after 0600Z.

headline: Port Sudan Airspace Restricted Above FL200
body: NOTAM issued for high-altitude transits due to localized kinetic activity. Civil operators advised to coordinate with regional ATC.
source: Sudan CAA / Reuters | Translation: Original English / Translated from Arabic

headline: Entebbe Runway 17/35 Maintenance Notice Issued
body: Visibility 10km+. Monitoring evening convective activity over the western highlands. No operational delays.

headline: Kigali (HRYR): VFR; SCT025 BKN100; Winds 210° at 6 kts
body: Surface winds north/northwest at 10 kts. Visibility steady at 8000m+ but monitoring CB development nearby.

headline: Mogadishu Airspace Security Protocols Tightened
body: SCAA reports increased electronic interference signals in the Aden Adde approach path. Pilots advised to maintain visual baseline.

headline: New Domestic Hubs Opening in Ethiopia
body: SOBUGEA announces 5% hike in turnaround fees for wide-body aircraft to fund cargo apron expansion.
source: Ethiopian Airlines Corporate | Translation: Original English / Translated from Amharic

headline: Bujumbura (HBBA) Ground Handling Fee Restructuring
body: Implementation of regional unified ATC standards delayed to Q4 2026. Current state-led fragmented monitoring remains active.
source: Burundi Ministry of Transport | Translation: Translated from French

headline: Julius Nyerere Intl (HTDA) Terminal 2 Lighting Upgrade
body: Night-ops capacity reduced by 15% during 48-hour electrical overhaul. Standby generators operational but secondary taxiways unlit.
source: TAA Official | Translation: Original English / Translated from Swahili

headline: HKJK: Heightened Security Checks — Kenya Airways Operations Affected
body: Enhanced passenger screening at JKIA following threat advisory. Kenya Airways (5Y-KQA) reporting 20–35 min ground delays on all departures. Coordinating with KCAA.
source: KCAA Security Bulletin | Translation: Original English

headline: HAAB: CB Activity on HKJK–HAAB Corridor; Ethiopian Airlines Advisory
body: Significant convective cells developing along the Nairobi–Addis corridor between FL240–FL360. Ethiopian Airlines (ET-AYA) flight ops centre monitoring; possible re-routing via HRYR.
source: TAF HAAB / Ethiopian Airlines Ops | Translation: Original English

headline: HTDA: Afternoon Thunderstorm Risk — Precision Air ATR Operations
body: Convective outlook for Julius Nyerere Intl indicates a 70% probability of TS activity 1400–1900 LT. Precision Air ATR 72-600 (5H-TGF) short-haul sectors to Zanzibar and Kilimanjaro flagged for potential holding.
source: TMA Tanzania Met | Translation: Original English / Translated from Swahili
